## How `Advanced` is derived

`Advanced` is the release cycle containing the last commit that touched the plan file — except that **sweeps are walked past**, because a mechanical edit is not progress. A pure-prose commit is a sweep once it touches more than 4 plan files; one that also ships code, more than 8 — shipping work can legitimately close several plans at once, bookkeeping cannot. A `\*` marks a row whose date was reached by walking past a sweep: it is older than `git log -1` on the file, on purpose.
